adjudication.rationale: The diff shows duplicated but inconsistent validation: the client `AddGuestsDialog` defines `ZAddGuestsInputSchema = z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)` to enforce uniqueness, while the server `addGuests.schema.ts` only validates `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness constraint. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out existing attendees/blacklisted emails but does not deduplicate duplicates within the submitted `guests` array, yet it can throw `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, implying uniqueness is expected. This mismatch means a direct/modified client can submit duplicate emails that the server will accept and attempt to `createMany`, potentially creating duplicate attendees or causing DB errors and inconsistent behavior.
